name: Unify
description: Connect Unify to Claude to run your outbound end to end: build target lists, enrich contacts with verified emails and phone numbers, draft personalized sequences, and sync it all back to your CRM. Then ask what's working: reply rates by sequence, rep activity, and conversion. Try asking "Find champions from my customer accounts who recently started new roles, get their verified emails and mobile numbers, and draft a sequence," or "Show me the breakdown of tasks completed by reps over the last 30 days." Unify searches 1.1B+ people and 65M+ companies across 40+ data providers. Find, enrich, and sequence prospects in one chat.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Unify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Unify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.unifygtm.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Unify MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unify lists 50 MCP tools, including answer_question, cancel_agent, complete_task, create_object, create_object_attribute, create_object_attribute_option, create_object_record, create_sequence_enrollment, create_task, delete_object, delete_object_attribute, and delete_object_attribute_option.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Unify?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Unify in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Unify requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Unify is developed by Unify. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
